method: No annotation contains 'multiciliated'; the atlas calls these 'ciliated epithelial'. Located the node 'Ciliated epithelial' (L2, 26304 cells) and took its subtree. A flat substring match on 'cili' agreed with the subtree in this case.
judgements: Reported at L3, not L4: the seven L4 children are mostly cell states (_Cyc cycling, _Diff differentiated, _eProf/_Early maturation stage) rather than distinct cell types.
Epi_FallopianCil_Fetal (516 cells) excluded although it is a developmental-stage rather than state distinction; user confirmed the L3-only selection.
Parent L2 'Ciliated epithelial' excluded: it is a three-organ roll-up and would duplicate the union of the three L3 populations.
Epi_OvarianInclCil included despite only 20 cells; atlas-internal evidence will be thin and the report may lean on literature. Flagged to the user, who confirmed inclusion.
Excluded as adjacent but not ciliated: Epi_OvarianInclSec, Epi_FallopianSec_*.
